title: Go: Reflection and Metaprogramming
description: Use Go's reflect package to inspect and manipulate types, struct fields, and methods at runtime.

steps.title: Type inspection with reflect.TypeOf
steps.description: Write a function `inspectType(v interface{})` that uses `reflect.TypeOf` to print the type name and kind of any value passed to it. Print results using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Kind distinguishes int, string, struct, slice, etc.

verification.failureMessage: Make sure all three type kinds appear in the output.

steps.title: Read struct field tags
steps.description: Define a struct `Config` with fields tagged like `` `json:"name" env:"APP_NAME"` ``. Use `reflect.TypeOf` and `.Field(i).Tag.Get(key)` to print all field names and their json/env tag values.
hints: NumField() returns the number of fields in a struct
StructField.Tag.Get(key) reads a specific tag key
Iterate with for i := 0; i < t.NumField(); i++

verification.failureMessage: Ensure both json and env tags are extracted.

steps.title: Set value via reflect
steps.description: Write a function `setField(obj interface{}, name string, value string)` that uses `reflect.ValueOf` and `.FieldByName` to set a struct's string field. Handle the pointer dereference and check settability with `.CanSet()`.
hints: ValueOf must receive a pointer for setting (.Elem())
CanSet() returns false for unaddressable values
Use .SetString() to set a string field

verification.failureMessage: Print the field value before and after the set operation.

steps.title: Iterate struct fields dynamically
steps.description: Write a function `printStruct(v interface{})` that uses reflection to iterate over all exported fields of a struct and print each field name, type, and value in the format `FieldName (Type) = Value`.
hints: Handle unexported fields by skipping or marking them

verification.failureMessage: Print each field in 'Name (Type) = Value' format.

steps.title: Call method via reflect
steps.description: Write a function `callMethod(obj interface{}, name string, args ...interface{})` that uses `reflect.ValueOf` and `.MethodByName` to find and call a method. Convert each arg to `reflect.Value` with `reflect.ValueOf` and call with `.Call(args)`. Print the result.
hints: MethodByName returns a Value or zero Value

verification.failureMessage: Print the method return value as 'result: ...'.

steps.title: Build a generic validator
steps.description: Create a struct validator using reflection. Tag fields with `` `validate:"required,min=3,max=100"` `` and write a function `validate(v interface{}) []string` that checks all validation rules and returns error messages. Print results with `fmt.Println`.
hints: Parse tag string by splitting on ',' then '='
For required, check if zero value using .IsZero()

verification.failureMessage: Ensure validation errors are printed to output.
